name: compass
description: Compass — an AI Engineering Manager that delivers one prose daily report.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm --filter @compass/web run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run arch && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @compass/web run dev
scripts.seed: pnpm run seed:generate && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @compass/worker run cold-start
scripts.smoke:docker: docker compose up -d --build && pnpm run smoke
scripts.perf:docker: docker compose up -d --build && pnpm run smoke && pnpm run perf
